subject: Biology
title: Anatomy of Flowering Plants
summary: Plant tissues meristematic (meristem — divide hone wale) ya permanent hote hain (simple: parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma; complex: xylem aur phloem).
Tissues teen tissue system mein organised hain: epidermal, ground (fundamental) aur vascular.
Dicot aur monocot ki roots, stems aur leaves ki andar ki structure alag hai — vascular bundles ki sankhya aur arrangement hi key hai.
Secondary growth (vascular cambium aur cork cambium) dicots aur gymnosperms mein girth badhaati hai, jisse annual rings, heartwood, sapwood aur bark bante hain.

formulas.name: Meristems
formulas.formula: apical (root and shoot tips — length);  intercalary (base of internodes in grasses — regrowth after grazing);  lateral (vascular cambium, cork cambium — girth)

formulas.name: Simple permanent tissues
formulas.formula: parenchyma (thin walls, storage, photosynthesis);  collenchyma (corners thickened with cellulose, hemicellulose, pectin — mechanical support in young dicot stems);  sclerenchyma (lignified, dead — fibres and sclereids)

formulas.name: Xylem elements
formulas.formula: tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres (dead);  xylem parenchyma (only living part)
formulas.mistake: Gymnosperms mein vessels nahi hote (Gnetum ke alawa); angiosperms mein hote hain — confuse mat karna.

formulas.name: Phloem elements
formulas.formula: sieve tubes + companion cells (angiosperms), phloem parenchyma, phloem fibres (only dead part)
formulas.mistake: Gymnosperms mein sieve tubes aur companion cells ki jagah albuminous cells aur sieve cells hote hain — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Protoxylem position
formulas.formula: exarch (protoxylem towards periphery — roots);  endarch (protoxylem towards centre — stems)

formulas.name: Vascular bundles
formulas.formula: radial (xylem and phloem on different radii — roots);  conjoint collateral open (with cambium — dicot stem);  conjoint closed (no cambium — monocot stem and leaves)

formulas.name: Dicot vs monocot root
formulas.formula: dicot: 2–4 xylem bundles (diarch–tetrarch), small pith, secondary growth;  monocot: more than 6 (polyarch), large pith, no secondary growth

formulas.name: Dicot vs monocot stem
formulas.formula: dicot: vascular bundles in a ring, open, endodermis (starch sheath), hypodermis collenchyma;  monocot: scattered bundles, closed, sclerenchymatous bundle sheath, water-containing cavities, hypodermis sclerenchyma, no pith/cortex distinction

formulas.name: Dorsiventral vs isobilateral leaf
formulas.formula: dicot: palisade + spongy mesophyll, more stomata on lower surface;  monocot: undifferentiated mesophyll, stomata equal on both surfaces, bulliform cells
formulas.note: Bulliform cells paani kho kar grass leaves ko mod dete hain, jisse paani ka nuksaan kam hota hai.

formulas.name: Stomata
formulas.formula: dicot: bean-shaped guard cells;  grasses: dumb-bell-shaped guard cells;  stomatal apparatus = pore + guard cells + subsidiary cells

formulas.name: Secondary growth outputs
formulas.formula: vascular cambium → secondary xylem (inside) + secondary phloem (outside);  cork cambium (phellogen) → cork (phellem, outside) + secondary cortex (phelloderm, inside)

formulas.name: Periderm and bark
formulas.formula: periderm = phellem + phellogen + phelloderm;  bark = all tissues outside the vascular cambium (including secondary phloem)

formulas.name: Annual rings
formulas.formula: spring/early wood: lighter, wide vessels;  autumn/late wood: darker, narrow vessels;  one light + one dark band = one year

examples.title: Root ya stem ka section?
examples.problem: Section mein radial bundles, exarch xylem aur pericycle dikh rahe hain. Root hai ya stem?
examples.solution: Root — radial bundles aur exarch protoxylem root ke features hain (stems mein conjoint bundles aur endarch protoxylem).

examples.title: Monocot stem
examples.problem: T.S. mein monocot stem pehchaanne ke teen features batao.
examples.solution: Bikhre hue vascular bundles, har ek ke saath sclerenchymatous bundle sheath; bundles conjoint aur closed; kinaare wale bundles beech walon se chhote; paani wali cavities; saaf pith nahi.

examples.title: Heartwood vs sapwood
examples.problem: Purane tane ka kaunsa hissa paani le jaata hai?
examples.solution: Sapwood (alburnum) — bahar ka halke rang ka secondary xylem. Heartwood (duramen) gaadha hai, tannins, resins, oils aur gums se bhara, conducting nahi par mazboot.

examples.title: Xylem mein living cells
examples.problem: Xylem ka kaunsa element zinda hai?
examples.solution: Xylem parenchyma. Tracheids, vessels aur xylem fibres maturity par dead hote hain.

examples.title: Bark ke components
examples.problem: Kya secondary phloem bark ka hissa hai?
examples.solution: Haan. Bark mein vascular cambium ke bahar ke saare tissues aate hain: secondary phloem, phelloderm, phellogen aur phellem.

examples.title: Grass leaf ka mudna
examples.problem: Garam sookhe din grass ki leaves kyun lipat jaati hain?
examples.solution: Upper epidermis ke bulliform cells turgor kho kar sikud jaate hain, leaf andar ki taraf lipat jaati hai aur khula surface aur paani ka nuksaan kam hota hai.

topics.title: Epidermal tissue system
topics.explain: Epidermis (aam taur par ek layer, waxy cuticle se dhaki — roots mein cuticle nahi), stomata, aur appendages: root hairs (epidermal cells ke unicellular extensions) aur stems par trichomes (aam taur par multicellular, branched ya unbranched, secretory bhi ho sakte).

topics.title: Ground tissue system
topics.explain: Epidermis aur vascular bundles ke alawa saare tissues: stems aur roots mein cortex, pericycle, pith aur medullary rays; leaves mein mesophyll.

topics.title: Endodermis and Casparian strips
topics.explain: Roots ki sabse andar wali cortical layer; iske cells ki radial aur inner tangential walls par paani na jaane dene wale suberin ki Casparian strips hoti hain, jisse paani ko living cells se hi guzarna padta hai.

topics.title: Formation of the cambial ring
topics.explain: Dicot stems mein intrafascicular cambium (bundles ke andar) interfascicular cambium (medullary ray cells se) ke saath judkar poora ring banata hai. Cambium andar ki taraf zyada active hai, isliye phloem se zyada secondary xylem banta hai.

topics.title: Lenticels
topics.explain: Bark mein lens jaise openings jahan phellogen cork ki jagah dheele packed complementary cells banata hai; inse bahar ki hawa aur andar ke tissues ke beech gas exchange hota hai.

topics.title: Secondary growth in roots
topics.explain: Dicot roots mein vascular cambium kuch phloem ke neeche ke conjunctive tissue se aur kuch protoxylem ke saamne wale pericycle se banta hai; pehle lehardaar ring banti hai jo baad mein gol ho jaati hai.

ratta: Xylem: only parenchyma living;  phloem: only fibres dead.
Root: radial, exarch;  stem: conjoint, endarch.
Dicot root 2–4 bundles; monocot root more than 6.
Dicot stem: ring, open;  monocot stem: scattered, closed.
